---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest something Idle should add
title: '[feat] '
labels: enhancement
---

**The problem**
What you're trying to do that Idle doesn't help with today.

**Proposed solution**
Your suggested behavior or feature.

**Alternatives**
Anything you considered or tried.

**Out of scope check**
Idle won't add these (see CONTRIBUTING.md):
- Multi-account farms or ToS-violating schemes
- Telemetry of any kind
- Auto-creating accounts on third-party services

If your feature touches any of those, this likely isn't the right project.
